content.short: Verichains is a Web3 security firm with cryptography and core blockchain technology expertise.
content.description: Since 2017, Verichains has established itself as a pioneer and leading blockchain security firm in APAC, with deep expertise in security, cryptography, and core blockchain technology. They serve over 200 clients and protect about $50 billion in assets, including BNB Chain, Klaytn, Wemix, Line Corp, Axie Infinity, Ronin Network, and Kyber Network. Verichains offers protocol and smart contract audits, mobile app security, key management, on-chain risk monitoring, and red team testing. Their team has identified vulnerabilities in layer-1, bridges, and smart contracts and helped resolve issues in the BNB Bridge and Ronin Bridge hacks.

resources.tldr: The ONTR token drained in minutes on Ethereum. Not a cryptographic puzzle or flash loan — the creator renouncing ownership was itself the flaw.
